ui.note: Document Better Auth 1.7.12 TOTP setup-key compatibility with a rolled-back 1.6 server, localized registration-unavailable and concurrent account-link refusals, and the six-locale forgot/reset-password journey. Reset tokens stay in memory outside session remounts; success explains removed credentials and retained two-factor settings; code-less 429s are localized. Show configured social/OIDC and SAML providers with explicit Settings linking/unlinking using the local account-row ID; preserve locale, theme and native approval. Zero 1.11 retains unknown-result loading and import activation. Storage/open/quota/transaction failures warn once per client, never claim on-device saving, refuse new offline edits and retain accepted edits for server sync. Read-only earlier-database scans warn incrementally about unsent edits and incomplete bounded checks; retirement checks pending mutations and waits for acknowledgement, not reconnect alone. Document five provider import pickers, immutable retry bindings, truncation notices, skipped Todoist descendants, restored ISO clocks/cross-day anchors, TickTick all-day precedence, valid-date Outlook ordering, timezone preview invalidation, recurrence/flattening/content limits and notification exclusions. Voice uses on-device recognition where supported; standard Web Speech requires vendor-service consent, stops on hidden/minimized tabs and remains unavailable in native webviews. Retired Android task-link reads show nothing; unavailable/signed-out/fenced refusals coalesce feedback without navigation or authority changes. Preserve existing sign-up, import focus handoff and already-open offline editing guidance. Focus uses exclusive server-timed spans, explicit offline proof and deferred completion reconciliation after reload; start/resume anchor elapsed time at the action.

release.note: Retain first-beta 0.1.0-beta.1/Android code 13 preparation, signing certificate, documentation epoch, remaining prerelease/native limits and prerelease publication wording. Add ditero-VERSION-clients.tar.gz with CLI/MCP/TUI JavaScript bundles, notices, per-file checksums, BUILDINFO and provenance attestation verified with a read-only attestations token. Packaging qualifies current and minimum Bun. Reject missing bundles/checksums/notices/attestation, bundled packages absent from notices, home/build paths, private-looking hosts/addresses, environment content, common secret shapes and build identity without building Bun. Standalone executables remain deferred; existing assets/signing/stable promotion rules remain. Packaging validates the Kustomize example as exactly two tag-matched image overrides.

configuration.note: Align Zero client/cache at 1.11.1, upstream Litestream configurations/forks and V5 backup defaults; retain app IDs, publications, slots and restricted roles, and document connection budgets and upgrade order. Add optional GOOGLE_, MICROSOFT_, GITHUB_, DISCORD_, FACEBOOK_, APPLE_, DITERO_OIDC_ and DITERO_SAML_* settings with _FILE forms, defaults and failure behavior; providers are off by default. Retain the explicit Compose Zero tag override and release suffix default. Kustomize gates Zero on the app build through commit comparison against app health, replacing the manual zero-replica hold. Missing/empty commits fail closed; local images need the same build commit. Overrides require exactly two tag-matched image names/replacement tags without extra fields. Document Kubernetes logical restore with original credentials, ciphertext and fresh Zero cache. Existing Helm values and stored formats remain unchanged; revert manifests for rollback. Focus clocks live in migration-owned server_private with runtime USAGE and SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only, outside default and explicit public Zero publications. Retain runtime/migrator shard grants.

deployment.note: Rebuild Zero and optional all-in-one runtime from the aligned reviewed package and PostgreSQL patch, preserving pinned Node and hardened backup dependencies while adding V5 configuration and replica migration/restore guidance. Compose/all-in-one pass optional social/OIDC settings; Helm uses extraEnv. SAML settings pass through Compose and the all-in-one bundle (file forms only there), with read-only key/certificate/metadata mounts. Defaults remain disabled. Preserve published Compose/Helm/Kustomize recovery guidance: database-first blob snapshots, original secrets, CNPG managed roles/logical restore and bounded diagnostics before cleanup. Kustomize automatically enforces app-before-Zero startup like Helm; alpha.12 upgrades remove manual hold patches. Retain the Compose Zero image override and existing release defaults; provider settings do not alter volumes or rollback procedures. Compose/CNPG initialize the private focus schema and restricted grants. Develop upgrades retain Zero caches; only earlier local branch caches containing public clocks need rebuilding.

native.note: Document desktop cold offline activation from complete unexpired session-bound OS credential evidence; trust, HTTP, validation, revocation and storage refusals fail closed. Authenticated native I/O persists a refusal fence, bounded Windows keyring chunks share references and use a recovery journal; earlier record formats need fresh online evidence, and downgrade needs stored-account cleanup. Failed local-storage retirement retains sync/credentials, reports unsent counts and permits retry after server acknowledgement. Android task links survive pre-handshake recreation and asset updates with digest-only pending tokens; failed verification retires stale links, notification taps require fresh launch, and page-generation refusals/dismissal are bounded and idempotent without account authority. Debug user CA trust rejects cleartext and is forbidden in release manifests; identifiers stay untranslatable. Hosted desktop journeys use ephemeral HTTPS and explicit debug-only OS probes excluded from optimized binaries. Windows toasts/macOS notifications capture ownership, use generic localized text/authenticated task destinations and exact withdrawal; Windows primes identity with a suppressed 15-second toast, dismissed banners leave no history, macOS weak-links a legacy backend and withdraws late timed-out additions. Real click/positive-popup controls gate granted journeys; hosted ad-hoc macOS denial requires fresh OS denial, localized reason, empty queues and no registration, leaving click/retirement unqualified. Durable sign-out cleans retired notifications; close waits handshake classification. Backends remain experimental: installers/shared checks do not qualify trusted signing, legacy OS, upgrades, physical devices or complete support. Debug diagnostics and fixed TLS fixture passwords change no release trust or protocol.

authentication.note: Upgrade Better Auth/passkey to 1.7.12 with additive JWT-key and unique provider-account migrations. Preserve Google callback, PKCE, native grant parameters and explicit approval; retain stable policy refusals and generic REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE outages. Configured social/OIDC registration requires verified email; Microsoft/Facebook require explicit owner linking, implicit same-email linking stays disabled, Microsoft/Apple use single-use nonces, non-Google client tokens stay refused and Apple origin trust is callback-POST-only. Account-existence/policy callbacks share a neutral code; concurrent links are refused, including raw link-social 409 JSON. Optional SAML requires operator configuration and signed assertions, defaults IdP-initiated off, keys identity by IdP entity ID plus NameID, retains admission policy and explicit linking, and uses native adapter transactions. Email reset always targets the web reset page and creates no session. One transaction consumes the token, writes the password, verifies mailbox control and revokes sessions/native Zero access, access tokens, calendar links, passkeys, provider links and pending account-bound 2FA/trusted-device/OTP/magic-link/passkey/OAuth/SAML pending-link proofs. Enrolled TOTP/backup codes, webhooks and channel credentials remain. Zero credentials is valid; no updated password row rolls back. Preserve live-session stream revalidation, HTTPS fragment invitations, validated identity updates, retained JWKS/secret checks and stopped-replica secret rotation. Registration discards nonidentity/password fields, keeps neutral timing on persistence failure and logs failures; IP ceilings precede bounded email buckets. Provider rollback may disable new providers without deleting rows; native credentials and approval remain unchanged. ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED uses its own localized concurrent-link message; the existing lowercase different-user error keeps its meaning.

compatibility.note: Better Auth adds nullable jwks.alg/crv and a duplicate-checked unique provider-account index, preserving encrypted Ed25519 keys and restricted roles. Zero 1.11.1 retains durable close/outage retry, acknowledgement/unknown-result guards and bounded predecessor retirement while server replicas migrate incrementally; 1.9 clients create fresh local databases and must drain unsent mutations first. Storage failures retain accepted mutations for server acknowledgement. Provider-content version 2 bindings validate dateOrder, anchorDay and nesting bounds while reusing version 1 intermediates/planner 4/writer/notification activation. Password reset also revokes SAML pending-link intents. Native/legacy import contracts remain. Existing attachment ciphertext/quotas and membership-leave cleanup remain unchanged; no TEMP grants are needed. Desktop protected credentials use bounded records/journals; earlier evidence needs online refresh. Focus migrations 0088/0089/0090 add IDs-only synced acknowledgements and move RLS-protected clocks to server_private outside Zero publications. Exclusive spans require full server-observed duration plus pauses; new starts close preceding spans. Auto-cycle waits for completion replay; unqualified observers cannot discard another tab proof opportunity even at per-interval reconciliation expiry. Evidence expires after 14 days; leader cleanup deletes at most 500 expired pairs per tick through a migration-owned fixed-bound function.
compatibility.upgrade: Drain every browser/native Zero 1.9 queue before replacing clients; keep offline clients on their old bundle until drained. Check/repair duplicate provider accounts, stop app and Zero, back up the matching recovery set and run additive better_auth_jwks, account_provider_unique and import-binding migrations as migration owner. Retain restricted NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS credentials, publications and slots. Start updated Zero before 1.11 clients and verify replica catch-up. Retain additive membership-leave migration, attachment directory permissions and original authentication secret. Earlier desktop evidence needs one complete online start. Apply focus migrations 0088/0089/0090 with Zero stopped, verify private grants, reload clients and start fresh intervals; older overlapping evidence is invalidated without rewriting sessions. Upgrades from develop need NO cache rebuild. Only earlier local branch caches containing public clocks need rebuilding; verify fresh sync and publication exclusion.
compatibility.backup: Keep coordinated PostgreSQL, attachment ciphertext, original encryption keys and authentication secret as one recovery set. Retain Zero replica snapshots and legacy/V5 backups through rollback and test V5 restore. Keep provider exports private for fresh preview. OS credential records are outside server backups; sign in online after server restore. Restore focus acknowledgement/private clock tables together with schema grants. Missing, expired or superseded evidence rejects server-proof completions; saved browser flags never authorize offline fallback.
compatibility.rollback: Drain 1.11 queues and downgrade clients before Zero; use a fresh disposable old cache, since 1.9 cannot read V5 backup paths. Preserve authoritative PostgreSQL. Better Auth 1.6.23 tolerates added nullable columns/index; retain additive migrations. Resume/discard new provider binding plans with the updated app before downgrade and stop new imports. Disable new providers without deleting their rows. Older desktop builds require sign-out/OS credential cleanup. Restore snapshots only with matching secrets/ciphertext and account for newer data loss; reverse secret rotation with replicas stopped. The preceding published app ignores focus tables. Intermediate focus builds expecting public clocks or acknowledgement timestamps require matching schema rollback from coordinated backup; preserve newer focus sessions.
compatibility.clientVersions: Zero 1.11 clients require a 1.11 server; sync all pending edits before replacing 1.9 local databases and never clear storage or uninstall undrained offline clients. Reload web TOTP callers after upgrade/rollback; method-less 1.6 setup replies remain accepted. Browser/Android/desktop sessions and native approval protocols remain compatible except intentional password-reset revocation. New web bundles expose five provider pickers; old clients cannot parse saved version 2 bindings and retain legacy imports. Native browser import stays unavailable. Desktop earlier credential evidence needs online refresh; runtime qualification limits remain explicit. Legacy clients without interval IDs retain legacy logging. Interval-ID clients need the explicit observing-page monotonic proof marker for offline completion; old queued completions still require server evidence. Unqualified observers leave shared intervals unresolved for another tab/delayed sync, show notice after ten seconds and may Stop to discard. Personal legacy/offline focus records are not tamper-proof.

clients.note: Ship CLI/MCP/TUI JavaScript bundles for user-installed Bun 1.3.14+; document archive/checksum verification, MCP launch, JSON --version, BUILDINFO building-Bun identity, source URLs and notices/license texts covering every bundled or dependency-inlined package. Standalone binary publication remains blocked/deferred.
